name: ai-api
title: AI API
about: OpenAI-compatible APIs for other programs, with keys, limits and usage.

apis.name: chat
apis.title: Chat
apis.about: Chat, text completions and Responses, streamed or not. With the agentic API off, Responses keeps no state: send the whole conversation.

apis.name: embeddings
apis.title: Embeddings
apis.about: Vectors for search and retrieval. nomic-embed-text wants each input to start with search_query: or search_document:.

apis.name: images
apis.title: Images
apis.about: Images from a prompt, with FLUX.2 klein 4B, one at a time, up to 768×768. It takes 10.7 to 13.1 GiB while it's on.

apis.name: transcription
apis.title: Speech to text
apis.about: Transcripts of recordings, their language found unless a request names it. Whistle on the CPU by default, in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Polish: 0.3 GiB. Whisper on the GPU as a choice, in 99 languages: 1.3 GiB. WebM, Ogg, MP4, MP3, FLAC or WAV.

apis.name: speech
apis.title: Text to speech
apis.about: Speech from text in Piper's voices, as WAV. GET /v1/audio/voices lists them. 0.4 GiB.

apis.name: agentic
apis.title: Agentic API
apis.about: Responses with conversations kept, Anthropic's Messages, and tools the unit runs itself, such as web search. Chat completions skip it.
